en_US: I found this creepy looking disc
near Team Galactic’s building.
I have no idea what it is...
It looks kind of dangerous, actually.
Do you want it?
I’d love to have it taken away.
Excellent! Thanks!
Though I wonder what the disc is for...
You don’t? Ahh...
Maybe I should sell it to somebody...
Team Galactic’s building bugs me so
much, I can’t sleep well.
It’s so bizarre, like a robot that’s
about to start moving.
Those thorny things on the building...
The way it moves meaninglessly...
I don’t understand their idea of
“awesomely fashionable” at all.
Still, Team Galactic does seem to have
a huge supply of energy.
